div.head: Hu 5
div.ab: Etiam (Amplius) diximus, si hundredum minet uestigium in aliud hundredum, ut notificetur hominibus illius (ipsius) hundredi, et ipsi (idem) cum eo uadant.
Eac we cwædon, gyf him hundred bedrife tród on oðer hundred, þæt mon cyðe ðam hundredesmen, ⁊ he ðonne ðær midfare.

Item diximus, quod, si persone unius centenarii sequantur uestigia (furati animalis) in territorium alterius centenarii, nuncietur concionatori (illius scilicet, quo iam peruenerunt), qui simul cum (illis) proficiscatur.
Eac we cwædon, gyf him hundred bedrife tród on oðer hundred, þæt mon cyðe ðam hundredesmen, ⁊ he ðonne ðær midfare.
We have further declared, that if one hundred follow up a track into another hundred, notice shall be given to the chief official of the latter, and he shall then take part in the search.
Further, we decreed, if one hundred follows up a trail into another hundred, that is to be made known to the man in charge of that hundred, and he is then to go with them.

Auch bestimmten wir: wenn ihm [dem Nachspürer verlorener Fahrniss] eine Hundertschaft die Spur in eine andere Hundertschaft leitet, dass man [es] dem Vorsteher letzterer Hundertschaft melde, und der dann da mitziehe [auf Nachspürung].

We also determined: if a hundred leads the track for him [the man tracing lost property] into another hundred, that it be reported to the head of the latter hundred, and that he then go along there [in the search].
